title: High Churn, High Charges Customers
description: This cluster represents customers who are likely to churn, indicated by a high positive deviation for 'Churn Label_No' and a negative deviation for 'Churn Label_Yes'. They also tend to have higher monthly and total charges. This group might be experiencing issues related to their internet service, as suggested by negative deviations in various internet-related features.

title: High Churn Risk: Fiber Optic, Month-to-Month
description: This cluster exhibits a significantly high likelihood of churn. Customers are more likely to have fiber optic internet, month-to-month contracts, and lack online security or tech support.  Higher monthly charges also correlate with this churn-prone segment.

title: No Internet, Low Monthly Charges
description: This cluster represents customers with no internet service, significantly impacting their online security and support needs. They also tend to have lower monthly charges. This suggests a segment that is not utilizing internet-dependent services. This pattern might indicate a specific demographic or service tier.

title: No Phone Service, DSL Internet
description: This cluster is defined by customers who exclusively use DSL internet and do not have any phone service. They also do not have multiple phone lines. Monthly charges are lower than average. This group represents a unique segment with specific service preferences.
